description: Per-keyword position series over time, oldest first — the same series the app's SERP-history chart draws for one tracked keyword. FREE: database only. No SEO data provider is called and no credits are spent. A `position` of `null` means checked but not found within that check's `searchedDepth` — a real event, not a missing check or a lost ranking. `searchedDepth: null` means the run predates that column, not that any particular depth was searched. At most one point per UTC day: a same-day re-check collapses to its latest reading.

configId.description: Rank tracker config ID. Call get_rank_tracker without a trackerId to list the project's trackers and their IDs.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

sinceDays.description: How many days back to look, 1–730. Defaults to 365.

trackingKeywordId.description: The tracked keyword's own row ID (from get_rank_tracker's results), not the keyword text.

name: get_rank_keyword_history
